title: Google Review NFC Cards For Gyms And Fitness Studios
summary: This page is for gyms, yoga studios and fitness clubs that want more Google reviews from active members and need a review prompt that fits reception, class check-in or post-session interaction without feeling awkward.
heroPoints: Fitness review prompts work best when they align with reception and member check-out moments that already exist.
Cards, stickers and desk prompts each fit different club layouts and member flow.
The first pilot should test member response at peak and off-peak times, not only in a quiet sample window.

faq.question: Where should gyms place review cards first?
faq.answer: They usually start best at reception or another staffed checkout moment where members are already stopping briefly and staff can naturally introduce the prompt.

faq.question: Do gyms need a different review format than restaurants or retail?
faq.answer: Often yes, because member flow, peak-time pressure and club layout change how practical a card or sticker prompt will be in daily use.
